\begin{document}
Test reading /etc/passwd path restriction.
\newread\passwdfile
\openin\passwdfile=/etc/passwd
\ifeof\passwdfile
  \message{PASSWD_OPEN_BLOCKED}
\else
  \read\passwdfile to\passwdline
  \message{PASSWD_LEAKED:\passwdline}
\fi
\closein\passwdfile
Done.
